preconditions.expression: all(0 <= start < N and 0 <= end < N for start, end, weight in edgeList)
preconditions.description: Vertices are within the valid range [0, N-1]

preconditions.expression: all(start < end for start, end, weight in edgeList)
preconditions.description: Edges are directed from start to end

preconditions.expression: all(weight > 0 for start, end, weight in edgeList)
preconditions.description: All edge weights are positive integers

postconditions.description: The result is -1 if there is no path from node 0 to node N-1, otherwise it is a non-negative integer representing the shortest path weight
